fee_notes: Single-unit fee is $40,000 per franchise. Multi-unit development discount applies: $30,000 per franchise for 3–8 Coffee Shops committed; $25,000 per franchise for 9 or more Coffee Shops committed. A separate Launch Fee of $10,000 per franchise is also required at signing but is described as a distinct fee from the Initial Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay an initial franchise fee of $40,000 for the Franchise Agreement that you sign for one ZIGGI'S Coffee Shop franchise, which applies regardless of whether you are acquiring rights to a Drive Thru, a Café with Drive Thru, or a Mobile Unit (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). You pay the Initial Franchise Fee in a lump sum on the date that you sign the Franchise Agreement.

For a Franchise Agreement signed under a Development Agreement, you will pay a reduced Initial Franchise Fee that varies based on the number of ZIGGI'S Coffee Shops you commit to develop. If you commit to develop three to eight Coffee Shops (including the Initial Shop), the Initial Franchise Fee is $30,000 per franchise. If you commit to develop at least nine Coffee Shops, you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $25,000 per franchise.
